preconditions.description: The number of stones n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a and 1 <= b and 1 <= c for a, b, c in stones)
preconditions.description: Each stone has three edge lengths a, b, c, all between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n lines of stone dimensions.

postconditions.description: The output specifies choosing either 1 or 2 stones.

postconditions.expression: len(indices) == k and all(1 <= idx <= n for idx in indices) and len(set(indices)) == k
postconditions.description: The output lists exactly k distinct stone indices between 1 and n.
If 2 stones are chosen, they must be glueable (share a matching face dimension pair).
The radius of the inscribed sphere for the chosen configuration is the maximum possible among all valid single stones and glueable pairs.
